_about: The Kirru crowd bodies (the Lead, 2026-10-30: Reedhollow's clutch, built by the creatures track's crowd generator; the characters track keeps the named Pell, Owa and the Kirru child). Each body is Pell's own build (assets_src/characters/pell/build_pell.py, the MPFB2 hero path with the Kirru head warp; pell.md) run on Pell's pell_params.json with these overrides deep-merged on top, so the bodies share his proportions, his head, fur, crest and whisker rules and his palette rules (pell.md section 5: wet dark brown, cream, reed gold and bone), and a fix to Pell reaches them on their next rebuild. Each body's `textures` sets the mantle's reed colours (pell_textures REED and REED_SHADE: bleached for the old, green for the young), and the costume and shell measures scale with its height (kirru_params). Only the LOD1 build ships (assets/crowd/<id>/<id>.glb, as the villager crowd bodies), with its textures at half Pell's resolution. Heights are the bible's (section 8: 2.1-2.4 m adults). Every body carries the carved name-shell (Pell's is the blank one) and a fishing-staff sized to its height (the Kirru fish; the clutch stands with its staffs like a flock of herons). Age shows only in the fur and the crest (pell.md section 1): grey guard hairs and paler, worn crest feathers.

kirru_man.about: An adult man of the clutch: a little taller and heavier than Pell, the darkest fur.

kirru_woman.about: An adult woman: slighter and a little shorter than Pell, warmer brown fur and a broader cream stripe.

kirru_elder_woman.about: An old woman of the clutch, grey at the muzzle and brows, her crest pale and worn.

kirru_youngster.about: A youngster of the clutch, not yet grown: shorter, a bigger head for the body, the softest crest.
